live_delta_window.scope: all repository changes after the last validated architecture-lineage fusion head through the live observed head

fused_hypothesis.claim: FRANK loop-of-loops recurrence can remain generic structured ClayCode control-flow while correctness and safety concentrate at orthogonal boundaries: bounded recurrence control, invariant-level snapshot/transaction consistency, and end-to-end capability/information-flow authority closure before external commit.
fused_hypothesis.shared_ancestry_warning: The loop-of-loops directive and branch repetition share ancestry; only the ClayCode proxy execution and two synthetic mechanism experiments add distinct executable evidence classes, not independent production-runtime replication.
fused_hypothesis.falsifier: A production H1/H2 implementation that safely supports concurrent recurrent state, deterministic replay and external effects without equivalent snapshot/version guards or authority-closure semantics would weaken or refute this synthesis.

cross_delta_findings.finding: Nested bounded recurrence lowered deterministically in a generic structured-control proxy with 2000 randomized differential cases and zero mismatches; this supports generic compiler/IR control-flow rather than a FRANK-specific recurrence primitive.

A recurrent episode that reads authoritative multi-field state should pin or validate a coherent snapshot/read-set before committing state or external effects; per-field atomicity alone produced fractured snapshots in 10/20 exhaustive legal interleavings.

Re-entry and dynamic Assembly composition must preserve source provenance and protected information-flow labels end-to-end; independently authorized read and sink effects can otherwise compose into an unauthorized joint capability in the synthetic counterexample.

The highest-information integrated test is a recurrence x concurrency x authority matrix: fixed/adaptive recurrent loops operating over versioned authoritative state while protected-source and external-sink effects are independently available, with stale-snapshot, provenance-loss, crash/retry and rollback injections.

global_invariants: snapshot consistency is required only at authoritative invariant boundaries; rebuildable derived state may remain epoch-tagged and eventually consistent if excluded from authority decisions
recurrent internal processing must not amplify capability across loop or Assembly boundaries
external effects require the existing external capability/commit gateway plus coherent state/version and provenance closure
shared branch repetition is convergence, not independent replication
Frank v0.1 implementation target is Ubuntu Linux developer system only

clayresearch.delta: Model the current architecture as three orthogonal control planes: recurrent-compute control, coherent authoritative-state commit, and capability/information-flow closure. Do not collapse them into one global controller or one emergence scalar.
clayresearch.next_test: Search for the minimal shared episode/commit contract that composes all three without making derived graph/GWT state authoritative.

frank.delta: Define each consequential recurrent episode with loop identity/budget/halt reason plus pinned state epoch or read-set, candidate state delta, commit validation and post-commit effect/outcome/re-entry receipt. Frank self-observation remains proposal-only for Harness changes.
frank.next_test: H1 Ubuntu episode replay with concurrent state mutation and stale-effect-commit injection.

gwt.delta: GWT may route admission/continuation/re-entry for expensive recurrence, but ignition/focus must carry or reference coherent state epoch/provenance and must never mint capability or bypass transaction/effect gates.
gwt.next_test: Compare fixed versus adaptive recurrence under matched snapshots while injecting concurrent state change and measuring false continuation/halt plus stale commit rejection.

emergenz.delta: Emergence experiments must treat fractured snapshots and authority amplification as confounds/failure modes, not higher integration. Causal contribution requires truthful coherent re-entry, lesion/rescue and outcome effects under preserved authority boundaries.
emergenz.next_test: Factorial recurrence x snapshot-coherence x truthful-reentry experiment with matched compute and explicit negative controls.

claycode.delta: Keep recurrence generic in parser/IR/control-flow. Add transaction/snapshot receipt obligations in runtime ABI/FFI/concurrency tests and preserve provenance/capability labels through dynamic Assembly composition; change language semantics only on executable counterexample.
claycode.next_test: Production parser->typed IR->type/effect->runtime implementation of bounded nested loops plus version-guarded commit and provenance-aware external effect closure on Ubuntu.

hyperposition.delta: Alternative recurrent routes/attractors must be version/epoch aware. Reopening or merging alternatives across stale authoritative state requires explicit rebase/validation; preserved alternatives must not carry stale capability provenance into a new commit context.
hyperposition.next_test: Matched attractor-reopening episodes across unchanged versus concurrently mutated state epochs, measuring recovery benefit and stale-route rejection.

claygraph.delta: Loop/coupling topology remains an epoch-bound derived projection. Add provenance-flow and transaction-epoch edges sufficient to audit dynamic Assembly composition, but graph activation/topology never authorizes state or effects.
claygraph.next_test: Project one H1 recurrent episode with transaction/version and protected-flow edges, then verify replay detects stale or provenance-broken paths.

unifieddb.delta: Prioritize invariant-group snapshot/serializable-equivalent boundaries, read/write-set or epoch receipts, conflict/retry lineage and effect-state binding. Keep non-authoritative caches/activation rebuildable and epoch-tagged rather than over-serializing the whole system.
unifieddb.next_test: Concurrency schedule suite for fractured snapshot, lost update, stale effect commit, crash between state/effect/outcome, and deterministic retry/replay.

harness.delta: Add an integrated Ubuntu H1/H2 stress matrix crossing recurrent depth/control, concurrent authoritative mutation and composed protected-source/network-sink capabilities. Require explicit receipts for state epoch, transaction outcome, provenance closure, effect authorization, rollback and re-entry.
harness.next_test: Execute minimal recurrence x concurrency x authority counterexample suite first, then expand to adaptive-budget and lesion/rescue comparisons.
